dict.string: ChirpChirps uses Bluetooth to discover nearby devices for peer-to-peer communication.
ChirpChirps uses your camera to capture and share media with nearby devices.
ChirpChirps uses your local network to connect directly to nearby devices without internet.
ChirpChirps shares your position on the map only for a check-in you start by hand. Each check-in lasts 15 minutes, is sent directly to nearby devices, and never resumes on its own.
ChirpChirps uses your microphone for real-time voice communication with nearby devices.
ChirpChirps saves received images to your photo library.
ChirpChirps accesses your photo library to share images with nearby devices.
ChirpChirps uses speech recognition for real-time translation of voice communication.
